name: Sirocco
personality: A charming, perceptive bard devoted to the goddess Kalla, poetry, and every woman he meets.
story: Sirocco is a mysterious 20-year-old bard who meets Leda during her revenge journey and joins her route automatically. On Cai/Dietrich he needs Renown 9+, Support 3, and a quest (give him the Monument Verse); on Theodora's route, Renown 5+ and the same quest. His deeper story role is not documented on the sources checked.

personalSkill.name: Goddess's Favor
personalSkill.effect: Restores 5 HP after combat. Lv 20: Wind's Caprice (random Avo bonus of +1, +5, or +20); upgraded at Lv 35.

tierNotes: Pocket Tactics: S. KeenGamer: S (one of the most balanced growth spreads, 40-50% across most stats).

why: Joins Leda's army automatically, so there's no Support or Renown to chase.

build.role: Main magic nuke and armor answer
path: Bishop (Part II side trip: Barrier, White toward S)
build.notes: Shaman (Ch 6 to 9) and Ovate (Ch 10) double his Black Magic for the armored maps. The Arena Mage course takes both schools to B. The Avatar needs White S and Black S: Ovate and Druid train Black; a Part II Bishop stint (White +3, Barrier) and a free Bishop switch in Part III push White.

guide.role: Magic nuke, armor answer and Dance target 1

guide.playstyle: Open each map inside Leda's Song of Passion ring (Mag +7 from Ch 9), delete armor and fliers from range 2, then let Leda dance him for a second cast. Goddess's Favor heals 5 HP after each fight.
keys: Seat him in Arena Mage Training weekly from Ch 5: Black B for Ovate, White B for Bishop
Shaman at Lv 20 (Ch 6) and stay: doubled Black Magic through Ch 9
Ovate the day he shows Lv 35 with Black B (Ch 10): the route's 2nd Advanced exam
Read Archive L (Ch 9) and Archive θ (Ch 9 or 11) the day you find them

Part II Ch 1 to 2: Bishop for Barrier and White +3, then Ovate for Dagda
watch: Def: 25 growth as Shaman and Ovate. Archers and cavalry kill him if he ends in reach
Weight: Magic Staff 3; Thunder 7, Cutting Gale 8. Levin Sword 8 only on turns he ends out of reach
Dark spells: Banshee 23, Luna 20. If spell weight counts (?), cast them only from out of reach

routeNotes.note: Partners here: Leda, Buccar, Mu and Olympia (all four support each other too), plus Sha Lan on the bench. Ch 11 and 12 meal: Leda + Sirocco + Olympia.
First Dance target from Ch 9: cast at range 2, dance, cast again. Special Dance's Spd +3 can turn a near-double into a double.
Song of Passion adds Mag +4 (+7 with Passion+ from Ch 9). Start each map inside Leda's ring, then cast.
He reads Archive L (Luna, Aditi's Cave, Ch 9) and Archive θ (Banshee, Iapetus Cavern, Ch 9 or 11). Archive Γ goes to Olympia.

decisions.pick: Shaman Ch 6 to 9, Ovate at Lv 35
decisions.why: The Arena Mage course trains White with Black, so White B needs no class. Priest would halve his Black casts and cut Mag growth to 50 on the armored Ch 7 and 9 maps, where he is the nuke.
decisions.else: Priest only if White is far from B in late Ch 8

decisions.pick: Bishop Ch 1 to 2 on a free Advanced License
decisions.why: White past B only comes from fights. Bishop adds White +3 a fight toward The Avatar's S and banks Barrier (Res +3 to adjacent allies) at no License cost.
Caladrius drops White Magic; Ovate is the Hard-mode video's pick and doubles his tomes as Dance target 1.

guide.playstyle: Nuke armor and low-Res targets from range; the Levin Sword covers 1 to 2 range without spending tome uses. Def grows 25%: back line only.

guide.summary: Slot 8 from Ch 7: the main black-magic nuke and second battalion carrier. Cast from one row behind Theodora's line at armor and fliers, and end next to Alexandra so her Silver Maiden counts him. He joins about 10 levels under the core, so feed him kills to reach Ovate by Ch 12.
guide.playstyle: Cast at range 2 from behind Theodora, then set his gambit tile before she ends her turn on the choke. Goddess's Favor heals 5 HP after each fight; from Lv 20 Wind's Caprice adds a random Avo roll.
keys: Renown 5 and the Monument Verse are his gate

Feed him finishing blows: Ovate at Lv 35 in Ch 12, else Part II Ch 1

watch: Join level: about Lv 15 in Ch 7, so Shaman at Lv 20 lands in Ch 8
